name: Lamia
location: Expand for Locations listClose Locations list

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack with claws that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Howling Strike
abilities.description: The lamia howls, indicated by a red cone, dealing moderate magic damage and staggering the target. Despite having yellow sparks, blocking this ability doesn't set the lamia off-balance.

abilities.name: Harmony
abilities.description: The lamia sings, granting 9,100/18,200 (Group Dungeons and Trials) spell and physical resistance for the caster and all allies within range for the duration of the effect. Affected enemies are highlighted. This can be interrupted to set the lamia off-balance. This cannot be cast if there is only one lamia.

abilities.name: Block
abilities.description: The lamia blocks, reducing damage taken. Heavy attacking a blocking lamia with a melee weapon causes the target to be staggered and be put off-balance. Only used when you attempt a melee attack at a lamia.

notes: Lamias summoned by Spinner Urthrendir only use the "Strike" attack.

Near the Shrine of Vakkan, Sandy shores of Western Solstice Lamias are a species of amphibious beastfolk. They have a serpentine appearance, with the head and tail of a snake and the torso of a woman. Lizards encountered in the Skooma Cat's Cloister transform into lamias upon approach.
